 Prime Video brings Madden and The Odyssey, Netflix debuts The Altruists and Paramount+ returns with Yellowjackets
 by Kurt Knutsson November 17, 2026 by Kurt Knutsson November 17, 2026 336 Facebook Twitter Email 49 Print this article At a glance Nicolas Cage plays a football legend in Madden, arriving on Prime Video November 18. 
 Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey becomes available digitally to rent or buy on November 17. 
 Netflix premieres the FTX drama The Altruists on November 19. 
 Yellowjackets begins its final season on Paramount+ November 20. 
 Looking for something new to watch? From Tuesday, November 17, through Tuesday, November 24, there is plenty arriving on your favorite streaming services. This week’s picks range from a football biopic and Christopher Nolan’s newest epic to an animated family adventure, a holiday romance and a crime documentary. Here are 10 movies and shows worth adding to your watchlist, along with the dates and places you can find them.

 Prime Video 
 Madden 
 Nicolas Cage takes on the role of football legend John Madden in this Prime Video original film, arriving Wednesday, November 18. Directed by David O. Russell, the movie follows Madden from his Raiders coaching days to his unexpected influence on the video game world. Christian Bale plays Raiders owner Al Davis, with Kathryn Hahn and John Mulaney also in the cast. You do not need to be a football fanatic to enjoy the behind-the-scenes story.
 Watch Madden 
 The Odyssey 
 Christopher Nolan’s epic adaptation of Homer’s ancient adventure arrives on digital platforms Tuesday, November 17. Matt Damon stars as Odysseus, with Anne Hathaway, Tom Holland and Zendaya among the ensemble cast. Expect a sweeping journey home filled with danger and mythological spectacle. Available to rent or buy digitally, although rental availability may vary by store. This is a paid release and is not included with a standard Prime membership .
 Rent or buy The Odyssey 
 They Will Kill You 
 If you prefer wild horror with a dose of dark comedy, They Will Kill You joins Prime Video on Friday, November 20. Zazie Beetz plays a woman trapped overnight in a building with a terrifying secret, while Patricia Arquette also stars. This blood-soaked action thriller had an earlier streaming run on HBO Max, but its arrival on Prime gives subscribers another way to catch up.

 The social-media reality competition starts a new chapter on Hulu on Tuesday, November 17, with Tinx taking over hosting duties. Contestants live apart and communicate through profiles, trying to figure out who is genuine and who is playing a character. The revived version mixes familiar reality-TV faces with new players and gives viewers a more interactive way to follow the competition.

 HBO Max 
 When a Witness Recants 
 Arriving Tuesday, November 17, this HBO documentary examines how a young witness’s testimony helped send three men to prison for a Baltimore murder they did not commit. Director Dawn Porter traces the consequences of the case and the effort to uncover what really happened. It is a sobering pick for anyone drawn to true-crime stories about the justice system rather than sensational twists.
 Watch When a Witness Recants 
 Tony 
 The A24 drama Tony lands on HBO Max on Friday, November 20, focusing on a young Anthony Bourdain before he became a celebrated chef and television personality. Dominic Sessa plays Bourdain during a formative summer working in a Provincetown kitchen. The film offers a more personal look at his early life, making it an intriguing choice for food lovers and longtime Bourdain fans.
 Watch Tony

 Netflix 
 Guarding Stars 
 Leighton Meester and Jared Padalecki headline this Netflix holiday romance, premiering Wednesday, November 18. She plays a serious bodyguard hired to protect a famous actor, but a trip to a Montana ranch has them pretending to be a couple. The holiday setting, celebrity complications and fake-relationship setup make this an easy choice for anyone ready to start their Christmas movie marathon.
 Watch Guarding Stars 
 The Altruists 
 Netflix turns one of the biggest cryptocurrency scandals into a scripted limited series on Thursday, November 19. Anthony Boyle stars as FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried opposite Julia Garner as Caroline Ellison, who led his trading firm Alameda Research. Across eight episodes, The Altruists explores the personalities, decisions and relationships behind the company’s spectacular collapse. This one could especially appeal to viewers interested in technology and true financial scandals.
 Watch The Altruists 
 Steps 
 Cinderella’s stepsisters get to tell their side of the fairy tale in Netflix’s animated movie Steps , premiering Friday, November 20. Ali Wong voices Lilith, Stephanie Hsu plays her sister Margot and Amanda Seyfried voices Cinderella. When Lilith steals the Fairy Godmother’s wand, the story veers into a chaotic adventure. It is a family-friendly option with a playful take on characters usually cast as the villains.
 Watch Steps

 The survival thriller returns for its fourth and final season on Friday, November 20. Yellowjackets continues its story across two timelines as the former high school soccer teammates confront the aftermath of their time stranded in the wilderness. If you have followed the mysteries from the start, this is a major premiere to put on your calendar. Watching on Paramount+ requires the Premium plan with SHOWTIME.

 Kurt’s key takeaways
 There is something for nearly every mood this week. Madden brings a big-name cast and an unusual sports story to Prime Video, while The Odyssey offers a major movie-night option for anyone willing to pay for a digital release. Netflix has both lighter family viewing and a timely tech-finance drama. And if you have been waiting for more Yellowjackets , the final season starts this Friday. Check the release dates before you settle in, especially for titles that arrive later in the week.
